definitions.explanation: A lotion, spray, or cream applied to the skin to protect it from the sun's ultraviolet rays and prevent sunburn.

examples.japanese: {日焼|ひや}け{止|ど}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}る→塗る：01174_nuru⟧。
{日焼|ひや}け{止|ど}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れた→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
{日焼|ひや}け{止|ど}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}ってから→塗る：01174_nuru⟧⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: I apply sunscreen before going outside.

examples.japanese: ⟦{汗|あせ}→汗：02173_ase⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かいた→かく：noentry⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧{日焼|ひや}け{止|ど}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}り{直|なお}した→直す：00869_naosu⟧。
examples.english: I reapplied sunscreen because I was sweating.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧{日焼|ひや}け{止|ど}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}らないと→塗る：01174_nuru⟧、⟦すぐに→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{赤|あか}く→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦なってしまう→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: In summer, if I don't apply sunscreen every morning, my skin gets red right away.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{日焼|ひや}け→日焼け：15469_hiyake⟧ (sunburn) + {止|ど}め (prevention). A product applied to the skin to block ⟦{紫外線|しがいせん}→紫外線：07375_shigaisen⟧ (ultraviolet rays).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日焼|ひや}け{止|ど}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}る→塗る：01174_nuru⟧: to apply sunscreen
- {日焼|ひや}け{止|ど}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}り{直|なお}す→直す：00869_naosu⟧: to reapply sunscreen
- {日焼|ひや}け{止|ど}め⟦クリーム→クリーム：00253_kuriimu⟧: sunscreen cream
- {日焼|ひや}け{止|ど}め⟦スプレー→スプレー：11581_supuree⟧: sunscreen spray

PRODUCT TERMS:
- SPF: sun protection factor (commonly used in Japanese too)
- PA: protection grade of UVA (Japanese labeling system)
